# Abeta React Ecosystem (`@abeta.dev/*`) — Full AI & Developer Reference

> Comprehensive single-file technical reference for LLM coding assistants, AI agents, and engineers integrating `@abeta.dev/ui`, `@abeta.dev/india`, `@abeta.dev/talent`, `@abeta.dev/auth`, and legacy `@abeta.dev/react-libs` (v0.21.0).

- **Version**: `0.21.0`
- **Runtime Requirements**: React `^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0`, Node.js `>= 20.0.0`, TypeScript 5+
- **Module Formats**: Dual ESM (`import`) and CommonJS (`require`) with full `.d.ts` / `.d.cts` declarations
- **Live Storybook**: https://abeta-dev.github.io/react-libs/
- **Concise Index**: https://abeta-dev.github.io/react-libs/llms.txt
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Abeta-dev/react-libs

---

## 1. Monorepo Package Matrix

| Package | Install Command | RSC / Server Entrypoints | Client Entrypoints (`'use client'`) | Primary Capabilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`@abeta.dev/ui`** | `npm i @abeta.dev/ui` | `./utils` | `.`, `./pdf`, `./hooks/use-toast`, micro-bundles (`./button`, `./card`, `./dialog`, etc.) | 111 accessible Tailwind v4 + Radix UI components, hooks, formatters, PDF viewer, CSS theme & precompiled bundle |
| **`@abeta.dev/india`** | `npm i @abeta.dev/india` | `.` (zero-bloat pure TS) | `./react` | GSTIN/PAN/IFSC/FSSAI/Pincode validators, `calculateGSTSplit`, `calculateTDS`, NPCI UPI URIs, `AmountSummaryCardIndia`, `UpiQrCard` |
| **`@abeta.dev/talent`** | `npm i @abeta.dev/talent` | — | `.` | `ProofOfWorkCertificate`, `CheckpointRunner`, `DiagnosticQuiz`, `PipelineKanban`, `ProofOfWorkCard`, `MatchScoreGauge`, `RadarSweep`, `SalaryRangeDisplay` |
| **`@abeta.dev/auth`** | `npm i @abeta.dev/auth` | `./core` (zero React) | `.`, `./react`, `./core/use-click-backpressure` | Headless `AuthClient` (HttpOnly cookie refresh, single-flight mutex, CSRF, epochs), `createAuthenticatedFetch`, `AuthClientProvider`, `AuthCard`, forms, OAuth PKCE |
| **`@abeta.dev/react-libs`** *(deprecated)* | `npm i @abeta.dev/react-libs` | `./utils`, `./india`, `./analytics` | `.`, `./india/react`, `./analytics/react`, `./pdf`, `./auth`, `./hooks/use-toast`, micro-bundles | 100% backward-compatible legacy omnibus re-export package |

---

## 2. Styling & CSS Delivery

### Strategy A: Tailwind CSS v4 Applications (Next.js App Router, Vite + Tailwind v4)

Add `@abeta.dev/ui/theme.css` after `@import "tailwindcss";` in your global CSS file (e.g., `app/globals.css` or `src/index.css`) and add `@source` directives pointing to every installed `@abeta.dev/*` package in `node_modules`:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@abeta.dev/ui/theme.css";

/* Required in Tailwind v4 so utility classes inside installed packages are compiled */
@source "../node_modules/@abeta.dev/ui";
@source "../node_modules/@abeta.dev/india";
@source "../node_modules/@abeta.dev/talent";
@source "../node_modules/@abeta.dev/auth";
```

### Strategy B: Non-Tailwind / Zero-Config Applications (Vite, CRA, Tailwind v3, Plain CSS)

Import the precompiled stylesheet once at your root client entry (`src/main.tsx` or `_app.tsx`). All library styles are wrapped in `@layer react-libs`, so your unlayered application CSS overrides library styles cleanly without `!important`:

```tsx
import "@abeta.dev/ui/style.css";
```

### Design Tokens & Multi-Brand Theming

`@abeta.dev/ui/theme.css` declares cascade layers (`@layer reset, base, react-libs, components, utilities, overrides;`) and semantic HSL CSS custom properties on `:root` and `.dark`:

- `--background`, `--foreground`
- `--card`, `--card-foreground`, `--card-border`
- `--popover`, `--popover-foreground`
- `--primary`, `--primary-foreground`, `--primary-border`
- `--secondary`, `--secondary-foreground`
- `--muted`, `--muted-foreground`
- `--accent`, `--accent-foreground`
- `--destructive`, `--destructive-foreground`
- `--border`, `--input`, `--ring`, `--radius`
- `--chart-1` through `--chart-5` (Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette)
- `--sidebar`, `--sidebar-foreground`, `--sidebar-primary`, `--sidebar-accent`, `--sidebar-border`

Override tokens on `:root` or apply `.theme-orange` to any subtree to rebrand components. Reduced motion (`@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`) is enabled globally by default.

---

### Hooks & Utilities

- **Hooks**:
  - `useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay = 400): T`
  - `useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): readonly [T, (v: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void]`
  - `useIsMobile(): boolean`
  - `useToast()` & `toast({ title, description, variant, action })` (also via `@abeta.dev/ui/hooks/use-toast`)
  - `useClickBackpressure(handler?, { debounceSec?: number | false, disabled?: boolean, onBlocked?: (reason: 'in_flight' | 'cooldown') => void })` → `{ execute, isPending, cancelCooldown, wrapHandler }`
  - `useLocalFirstStore<T>({ key, initialValue, version?, onMigrate? })` → `{ data, setData, resetData, exportJson, importJson, isHydrated }`
  - `useOfflineQueue<T>({ dbName?, storeName?, syncHandler?, maxRetries?, autoSyncOnOnline? })` → `{ isOnline, pendingCount, isSyncing, queue, enqueue, remove, clear, flushQueue }`
  - `usePlatform()` → `{ ...PlatformInfo, triggerHaptic, nativeShare }`
  - `usePWAInstall()` → `{ canInstall, isInstalled, isIOS, promptInstall }`
- **Formatters**: `formatCurrency(amount, currency = "USD", locale = "en-US")`, `formatNumber`, `formatDate`, `formatDateTime`, `formatRelativeTime`, `formatWeight`, `formatQuantity`, `formatFileSize`, `formatPercent`, `formatLocalizedDate`, `formatLocalizedDateTime`, `formatLocalizedNumber`, `formatBytes`.
- **Masking**: `maskSensitiveValue(value, { isMasked?, maskPattern?, dataType?, formatAsCurrency? })`.
- **Universal Validators**: `cleanPhoneNumber`, `isValidEmail`, `isValidPhone`, `validateEmail`, `validatePhone`, `validatePostalCode`, `validateTaxId`, `validateBankAccount`, `validateRoutingCode`, `validateUrl`, `validatePassword`, `validateRequired`, `validatePositiveNumber`, `validateDateRange`, `validateTimeRange`.

### Recipes (`@abeta.dev/ui`)

#### Button with Built-In Click Debouncing & Async Backpressure

`Button` automatically prevents duplicate clicks (default 1s cooldown + async promise lock). Pass `debounceSec={false}` for rapid-fire controls like pagination or zoom.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@abeta.dev/ui/button";
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@abeta.dev/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@abeta.dev/ui/badge";

export function ApprovalCard({ onApprove }: { onApprove: () => Promise<void> }) {
  const [approved, setApproved] = useState(false);

  async function handleApprove() {
    await onApprove();
    setApproved(true);
  }

  return (
    <Card className="max-w-md">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <CardTitle>Purchase Order #PO-4821</CardTitle>
          <Badge variant={approved ? "default" : "secondary"}>
            {approved ? "Approved" : "Pending"}
          </Badge>
        </div>
        <CardDescription>Async click backpressure prevents double submissions.</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Total value: $14,800.00 · Net 30 terms
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter className="justify-end gap-2">
        <Button variant="outline" debounceSec={false} onClick={() => setApproved(false)}>
          Reset
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={handleApprove} loadingText="Approving...">
          Approve PO
        </Button>
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

#### DataTable + StatusBadge + ConfirmDialog

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { DataTable, type DataTableColumn, StatusBadge, ConfirmDialog, Button } from "@abeta.dev/ui";

interface InvoiceRow {
  id: string;
  vendor: string;
  amount: string;
  status: "paid" | "pending" | "overdue_payment";
}

export function InvoicesTable({ rows }: { rows: InvoiceRow[] }) {
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  const columns: DataTableColumn<InvoiceRow>[] = [
    { key: "id", header: "Invoice #", sortable: true },
    { key: "vendor", header: "Vendor" },
    { key: "amount", header: "Amount" },
    { key: "status", header: "Status", cell: (row) => <StatusBadge status={row.status} /> },
    {
      key: "actions",
      header: "",
      cell: (row) => (
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setSelectedId(row.id)}>
          Void
        </Button>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <DataTable
        columns={columns}
        data={rows}
        rowKey={(row) => row.id}
        pagination={{ page, pageSize: 10, total: rows.length, onPageChange: setPage }}
      />
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={selectedId !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => { if (!open) setSelectedId(null); }}
        title="Void Invoice?"
        description="This action marks the invoice as void and cannot be undone."
        variant="destructive"
        confirmLabel="Void Invoice"
        onConfirm={() => setSelectedId(null)}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Toaster } from "@abeta.dev/ui";
import { Button } from "@abeta.dev/ui/button";
import { useToast } from "@abeta.dev/ui/hooks/use-toast";

export function SaveAction() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  return (
    <>
      <Button
        onClick={() =>
          toast({
            title: "Vendor saved",
            description: "GSTIN and settlement details have been synced.",
          })
        }
      >
        Save Vendor
      </Button>
      <Toaster />
    </>
  );
}
```

## 4. `@abeta.dev/india` — Zero-Bloat India Statutory, GST & UPI

### Architecture & Entrypoints

- **`@abeta.dev/india`** (RSC & Server-Safe): Pure TypeScript with zero React, DOM, or UI component dependencies. Safe in Next.js Server Components, Server Actions, Route Handlers, Node.js scripts, and Edge runtimes.
- **`@abeta.dev/india/react`** (`'use client'`): Interactive regional React components (`AmountSummaryCardIndia`, `UpiQrCard`, `LanguageToggle`, `BilingualTooltip`).

### Pure Domain API (`@abeta.dev/india`)

#### Statutory Validators (Bilingual English `'en'` & Hindi `'hi'`)
All validators return `undefined` when valid, or an error message `string` when invalid (`validateFSSAI` treats empty input as optional/valid):

- `validateGSTIN(value?: string | null, options?: { language?: 'en' | 'hi' }): string | undefined`
- `validatePAN(value?: string | null, options?: { language?: 'en' | 'hi' }): string | undefined`
- `validateIFSC(value?: string | null, options?: { language?: 'en' | 'hi' }): string | undefined`
- `validatePhoneIN(value?: string | null, options?: { language?: 'en' | 'hi' }): string | undefined`
- `validateBankAccountIN(value?: string | null, options?: { language?: 'en' | 'hi' }): string | undefined`
- `validateFSSAI(value?: string | null, options?: { language?: 'en' | 'hi' }): string | undefined`
- `validatePincode(value?: string | null, options?: { language?: 'en' | 'hi' }): string | undefined`
- `cleanPhoneNumber(phone: string): string`
- Regex constants: `REGEX_GSTIN`, `REGEX_PAN`, `REGEX_PHONE_IN`, `REGEX_IFSC`, `REGEX_BANK_ACCOUNT_IN`, `REGEX_FSSAI`, `REGEX_PINCODE`
- Message catalogs: `VALIDATION_MESSAGES_IN`, `VALIDATION_MESSAGES_IN_HI`

#### GST & TDS Tax Calculation Engine
- `calculateGSTSplit(amount: number, taxRate = 18, isIntraState = true, isTaxInclusive = false): GSTCalculationResult`
  - Returns `{ baseAmount, totalTax, cgstAmount, sgstAmount, igstAmount, totalPayable }`
  - When `isIntraState === true`: splits tax 50/50 into `cgstAmount` and `sgstAmount` (`igstAmount === 0`).
  - When `isIntraState === false`: sets `igstAmount = totalTax` (`cgstAmount === 0`, `sgstAmount === 0`).
- `calculateTDS(baseAmount: number, tdsPercentage: number): number`

#### NPCI UPI Payment URI Engine
- `validateUpiId(upiId: string): UpiValidationResult` → `{ isValid: boolean; error?: string }`
- `generateUpiPayUri(options: UpiPayOptions): string`
  - `UpiPayOptions`: `{ upiId: string; payeeName?: string; amount?: number; transactionNote?: string; currency?: string; transactionRef?: string; merchantCode?: string; refUrl?: string }`
- `parseUpiPayUri(uri: string): UpiPayOptions | null`

#### Currency Units, Locations & WhatsApp Helpers
- `formatLakhs(value: number, currencySymbol = "₹"): string` (e.g. `₹3.5L`)
- `formatCrores(value: number, currencySymbol = "₹"): string` (e.g. `₹1.25Cr`)
- `INDIAN_LANGUAGES` (`IndianLanguageOption[]`), `INDIA_STATES` (`IndiaState[]`), `INDIA_CITIES` (`IndiaCity[]`)
- `getCitiesForState(stateCode: string)`, `getStateOptions(placeholder?)`, `getCityOptions(stateCode, placeholder?)`, `isMetroCity(cityName)`
- `formatPhoneForWhatsApp(phone, defaultCountryCode = "91")`, `generateWhatsAppUrl(phone?, message?, defaultCountryCode?)`, `generateWhatsAppAppUrl(phone?, message?, defaultCountryCode?)`, `openWhatsApp(phone?, message?, defaultCountryCode?)`, `formatWhatsAppTemplate(template, variables)`

### Client React Components (`@abeta.dev/india/react`)

- **`AmountSummaryCardIndia`**:
  - Props: `baseAmount?: number`, `gstRate?: number` (default `18`), `isIntraState?: boolean` (default `true`), `isTaxInclusive?: boolean` (default `false`), `transportCost?: number`, `tdsPercentage?: number`, `netPayable?: number`, `isUrgent?: boolean`, `urgentLabel?: string`, `size?: "sm" | "default"`.
- **`UpiQrCard`**:
  - Props: `upiId: string` *(required)*, `payeeName?: string`, `amount?: number`, `transactionNote?: string`, `showStandee?: boolean` (default `true`), `size?: number` (default `180`), `onDownloadReady?: (dataUrl: string) => void`, `badgeLabel?: string`.
- **`LanguageToggle`**:
  - Props: `onLanguageChange?: (lang: string) => void`, `className?: string`.
- **`BilingualTooltip`**:
  - Props: `englishText: string`, `hindiText: string`, `children: React.ReactNode`, `className?: string`.

### Recipes (`@abeta.dev/india`)

#### Server-Side GSTIN Validation, GST Split & UPI URI (RSC / Server Action)

```ts
import {
  validateGSTIN,
  validatePAN,
  validateIFSC,
  validateUpiId,
  calculateGSTSplit,
  calculateTDS,
  generateUpiPayUri,
} from "@abeta.dev/india";

export function prepareVendorSettlement(input: {
  gstin: string;
  pan: string;
  ifsc: string;
  upiId: string;
  baseAmount: number;
  isIntraState: boolean;
}) {
  const gstinError = validateGSTIN(input.gstin); // undefined if valid
  const panError = validatePAN(input.pan);
  const ifscError = validateIFSC(input.ifsc);
  const upiCheck = validateUpiId(input.upiId);

  if (gstinError || panError || ifscError || !upiCheck.isValid) {
    throw new Error(gstinError ?? panError ?? ifscError ?? upiCheck.error ?? "Invalid statutory details");
  }

  const gst = calculateGSTSplit(input.baseAmount, 18, input.isIntraState, false);
  const tds = calculateTDS(gst.baseAmount, 2); // Section 194C 2%
  const netPayable = Math.max(0, gst.totalPayable - tds);

  const upiUri = generateUpiPayUri({
    upiId: input.upiId,
    payeeName: "Abeta Vendor Settlement",
    amount: netPayable,
    transactionNote: "Invoice #INV-2026-1042",
  });

  return { gst, tds, netPayable, upiUri };
}
```

#### Client-Side Invoice Breakdown & UPI QR Standee

```tsx
"use client";

import { AmountSummaryCardIndia, UpiQrCard } from "@abeta.dev/india/react";

export function InvoiceCheckout() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
      <AmountSummaryCardIndia
        baseAmount={125000}
        gstRate={18}
        isIntraState={true}
        tdsPercentage={2}
        transportCost={1500}
        isUrgent
        urgentLabel="T+0 Settlement"
      />
      <UpiQrCard
        upiId="billing@okhdfcbank"
        payeeName="Abeta Logistics Pvt Ltd"
        amount={146500}
        transactionNote="Invoice #INV-2026-1042"
        badgeLabel="0% Commission Direct UPI"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 5. `@abeta.dev/talent` — Assessment, Credentials & Hiring Pipeline UI

All exports from `@abeta.dev/talent` are `'use client'` React components:

- **`ProofOfWorkCertificate`**: Verifiable print-ready certificate with `@media print` styling, hydration-safe date rendering, clipboard copy, and Web Share API fallback.
  - Required props: `certificateId: string`, `recipientName: string`, `projectTitle: string`.
  - Optional props: `recipientHandle?: string`, `projectSlug?: string`, `issueDate?: string`, `issuerName?: string`, `issuerLogoUrl?: string`, `skills?: string[]`, `verificationUrl?: string`, `showActions?: boolean`, `onPrint?: () => void`, `onShare?: () => void`.
- **`CheckpointRunner`**: Sequential milestone verification runner with runnable command snippets, copy button, expandable hints, and evidence capture.
  - Props: `checkpoints: CheckpointItem[]` (`{ id, title, command?, hint?, evidenceRequired?, completed?, evidence? }`), `onToggleCheckpoint?: (id: string, evidence?: string) => void`, `onRunCommand?: (command: string) => Promise<string | void> | void`, `title?: string`, `description?: string`.
- **`DiagnosticQuiz`**: Multi-step modal assessment dialog that computes weighted track recommendations.
  - Props: `open: boolean`, `onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void`, `questions: QuizQuestion[]` (`{ id, title, category?, options: { label, description?, trackAffinity, weight? }[] }`), `onComplete: (recommendedTrack: string, scores: Record<string, number>) => void`, `title?: string`, `description?: string`.
- **`PipelineKanban`**: Multi-column candidate/deal pipeline board with keyboard-accessible cards (`Enter`/`Space`), column counts, tones (`"default" | "indigo" | "emerald" | "amber" | "rose" | "purple"`), and add-card actions.
  - Props: `columns: KanbanColumn[]` (`{ id, title, count?, items: KanbanCardItem[], tone?, emptyMessage? }`), `onCardClick?: (item: KanbanCardItem, columnId: string) => void`, `onAddCard?: (columnId: string) => void`, `emptyMessage?: string`.
- **`ProofOfWorkCard`** (alias: `MetricVerificationCard`): Single artifact proof card (`item: ProofOfWorkItem`).
- **`MatchScoreGauge`**: Circular SVG score meter (`role="meter"`, props: `score`, `label?`, `sublabel?`, `size?`, `strokeWidth?`, `showGrade?`).
- **`RadarSweep`**: Animated radar blip visualization (`size?`, `blips?: RadarBlip[]`, `isScanning?`, `statusText?`).
- **`SalaryRangeDisplay`** (aliases: `MetricRangeDisplay`, `CompensationRangeDisplay`): Badge or card compensation display (`min?`, `max?`, `currencySymbol?`, `unit?`, `period?`, `label?`, `breakdown?`, `items?`, `variant?: "badge" | "card"`).

### Recipes (`@abeta.dev/talent`)

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  ProofOfWorkCertificate,
  CheckpointRunner,
  DiagnosticQuiz,
  PipelineKanban,
  type CheckpointItem,
  type KanbanColumn,
} from "@abeta.dev/talent";

export function TalentDemo() {
  const [quizOpen, setQuizOpen] = useState(false);
  const [checkpoints, setCheckpoints] = useState<CheckpointItem[]>([
    { id: "cp-1", title: "Run unit test suite", command: "npm test", completed: true },
    { id: "cp-2", title: "Attach verified commit SHA", evidenceRequired: true, hint: "Run git rev-parse HEAD" },
  ]);

  const columns: KanbanColumn[] = [
    {
      id: "screening",
      title: "Screening",
      tone: "indigo",
      items: [{ id: "cand-1", title: "Ananya Verma", subtitle: "Staff Frontend Engineer", score: 94, tag: "React 19" }],
    },
    {
      id: "offer",
      title: "Offer",
      tone: "emerald",
      items: [{ id: "cand-2", title: "Rohan Mehta", subtitle: "Distributed Systems", scoreLabel: "Top 5%", tag: "Verified" }],
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <CheckpointRunner
        checkpoints={checkpoints}
        onToggleCheckpoint={(id, evidence) =>
          setCheckpoints((prev) =>
            prev.map((cp) => (cp.id === id ? { ...cp, completed: !cp.completed, evidence } : cp))
          )
        }
      />

      <ProofOfWorkCertificate
        certificateId="POW-2026-9042"
        recipientName="Aarav Sharma"
        recipientHandle="@aarav"
        projectTitle="Multi-Tenant Vendor Portal Engine"
        issuerName="Abeta Engineering Academy"
        issueDate="2026-11-20"
        skills={["React 19", "TypeScript", "Tailwind v4", "GST Engine"]}
        verificationUrl="https://verify.abeta.dev/cert/POW-2026-9042"
        showActions
      />

      <PipelineKanban
        columns={columns}
        onCardClick={(item, columnId) => console.log(item.id, columnId)}
      />

      <DiagnosticQuiz
        open={quizOpen}
        onOpenChange={setQuizOpen}
        title="Engineering Track Diagnostic"
        questions={[
          {
            id: "q-1",
            title: "Which layer do you enjoy optimizing most?",
            options: [
              { label: "Design Systems & Accessibility", trackAffinity: "frontend", weight: 3 },
              { label: "Distributed Consensus & Storage", trackAffinity: "systems", weight: 3 },
            ],
          },
        ]}
        onComplete={(track, scores) => console.log("Recommended:", track, scores)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

## 6. `@abeta.dev/auth` — Headless Session Engine & Auth UI

### Entrypoints

- **`@abeta.dev/auth/core`** *(pure TypeScript, zero React, zero `'use client'`)*:
  - `AuthClient<TUser>`: Headless session state machine storing access tokens in memory only, with single-flight HttpOnly cookie refresh, epoch guards against stale login/logout races, CSRF token injection, and optional cross-tab `RefreshCoordinator`.
  - `createAuthenticatedFetch<TUser>(auth, allowedOrigin, fetchImpl?)`: Origin-locked Bearer fetch wrapper with `redirect: 'error'` and at-most-once eligible retry on explicit `isAccessExpired(response)` + `replay()`.
  - `AuthClientError` + types (`AuthClientOptions`, `AuthClientAdapter`, `AuthClientSession`, `AuthClientSnapshot`, `AuthClientStatus`, `CsrfProvider`, `RefreshCoordinator`, `AccessSessionPersistence`, `AuthCapabilities`, `AuthenticatedFetchClient`, `AuthenticatedFetchOptions`).
- **`@abeta.dev/auth/react`** *(`'use client'`)*:
  - Headless client bindings: `AuthClientProvider`, `useAuthClient`, `useAuthClientSnapshot`.
  - Adapter-backed context & hooks: `AuthProvider`, `AuthContext`, `useAuth`, `useToken`, `useUser`, `useOAuth`.
- **`@abeta.dev/auth`** *(`'use client'`, full package)*:
  - Re-exports core + React hooks + UI components (`AuthCard`, `LoginForm`, `SignUpForm`, `ForgotPasswordForm`, `OtpForm`, `OAuthButton`, `OAuthButtonGroup`), `TokenManager`, `MockAuthAdapter`, `DEFAULT_MOCK_PASSWORD`, PKCE utilities (`generateOAuthState`, `generateCodeVerifier`, `generateCodeChallenge`, `isValidRedirectUrl`), `useClickBackpressure`, and OAuth icons (`GoogleIcon`, `LinkedInIcon`, `GitHubIcon`, `AppleIcon`, `MicrosoftIcon`, `EyeIcon`, `EyeOffIcon`, `SpinnerIcon`).
- **`@abeta.dev/auth/core/use-click-backpressure`**: Standalone `useClickBackpressure` hook.

### Recipe 1: Headless Cookie-Backed `AuthClient` + `createAuthenticatedFetch` + React Provider

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { AuthClient, createAuthenticatedFetch, type AuthClientAdapter, type CsrfProvider } from "@abeta.dev/auth/core";
import { AuthClientProvider, useAuthClient, useAuthClientSnapshot } from "@abeta.dev/auth/react";

const csrf: CsrfProvider = {
  async getToken(signal) {
    const res = await fetch("https://api.example.com/auth/csrf", { credentials: "include", signal });
    const json = (await res.json()) as { csrfToken: string };
    return json.csrfToken;
  },
};

// Implement AuthClientAdapter against your backend endpoints (cookie-backed refresh, finite expiresAt ms)
declare const adapter: AuthClientAdapter;

export const authClient = new AuthClient({
  adapter,
  csrf,
  refreshThresholdMs: 60_000,
});

export const apiClient = createAuthenticatedFetch(authClient, "https://api.example.com");

export function AppAuthShell({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    void authClient.bootstrap();
  }, []);

  return <AuthClientProvider client={authClient}>{children}</AuthClientProvider>;
}

export function SessionHeader() {
  const client = useAuthClient();
  const snapshot = useAuthClientSnapshot();

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b px-4 py-3">
      <div className="text-sm">
        <span className="font-medium">{snapshot.session?.user.email ?? "Guest"}</span>
        <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">({snapshot.status})</span>
      </div>
      {snapshot.status === "authenticated" && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void client.logout()} className="text-sm underline">
          Sign out
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Recipe 2: Drop-In `AuthProvider` + `AuthCard`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { AuthProvider, AuthCard, MockAuthAdapter } from "@abeta.dev/auth";

export function SignInPage() {
  const adapter = useMemo(() => new MockAuthAdapter(), []);

  return (
    <AuthProvider adapter={adapter}>
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center p-6">
        <AuthCard
          initialMode="signIn"
          providers={["google", "linkedin"]}
          title="Vendor Portal"
          subtitle="Sign in to manage purchase orders and settlements"
          onSuccess={(session) => console.log("Signed in as:", session.user.email)}
        />
      </div>
    </AuthProvider>
  );
}
```

---

## 7. Behavioral Analytics & Legacy Omnibus (`@abeta.dev/react-libs`)

- **Pure Analytics Engine (RSC/Server-Safe)**: `@abeta.dev/react-libs/analytics` (`initAnalytics`, `trackEvent`, `createAnalyticsEngine`, `ConsoleAdapter`, `HttpAdapter`, `GoogleAnalyticsAdapter`, `MixpanelAdapter`).
- **React Analytics Bindings (`'use client'`)**: `@abeta.dev/react-libs/analytics/react` (`AnalyticsProvider`, `useAnalytics`, `TrackArea`, `PageViewTracker`).
- **Legacy Omnibus (`@abeta.dev/react-libs`)**: Deprecated for greenfield apps in favor of `@abeta.dev/ui`, `@abeta.dev/india`, `@abeta.dev/talent`, and `@abeta.dev/auth`, while maintaining 100% backward compatibility for all legacy import paths.

---

## 8. Common Mistakes to Avoid (Checklist for AI Agents)

1. **Tailwind v4 `@source`**: Never forget `@source "../node_modules/@abeta.dev/ui";` (and other installed scoped packages) when using `@import "@abeta.dev/ui/theme.css";`, or utility classes inside package components will not be emitted.
2. **RSC Boundaries**: Do not import from `@abeta.dev/ui`, `@abeta.dev/india/react`, `@abeta.dev/talent`, or `@abeta.dev/auth/react` in a Next.js Server Component without a `'use client'` wrapper. Import pure validators/tax functions from `@abeta.dev/india` and `cn` from `@abeta.dev/ui/utils` directly in Server Components.
3. **Exact Prop Names**:
   - `UpiQrCard` & `generateUpiPayUri`: use `upiId`, NOT `payeeVpa`.
   - `calculateGSTSplit`: capital `GST` and 3rd argument is `isIntraState` (`true` = CGST+SGST, `false` = IGST).
   - `validateGSTIN` / `validatePAN` / `validateIFSC`: return `undefined` when valid, error string when invalid.
   - `validateUpiId`: returns `{ isValid: boolean, error?: string }`, NOT a raw boolean.
   - `PdfViewer`: use `file` prop (NOT `url`), imported from `@abeta.dev/ui/pdf`, and `onLoadSuccess` receives `numPages: number`.
   - `ProofOfWorkCertificate`: requires `certificateId`, `recipientName`, and `projectTitle` (NOT `courseTitle`).
   - `useAuthClientSnapshot()`: user lives at `snapshot.session?.user`, NOT `snapshot.user`.
   - `useClickBackpressure(handler, opts)`: returns `{ execute, isPending, cancelCooldown, wrapHandler }`.
